blocks.text: Part 1. AI Use Disclosure (public page)
**Last updated:** [EFFECTIVE DATE]    |    **Version:** [VERSION]

**EMERGENCY.** Automated tools, including the WellPeps assistant, cannot respond to emergencies. If you think you are having a medical emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room right away. If you are thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988. If you may have taken too much medicine or the wrong dose, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222.
1. The short version
The only AI tool WellPeps runs today is the WellPeps assistant on wellpeps.com. It is the “Ask WellPeps” chat window.
The assistant answers questions about WellPeps and general health topics using our own articles and program pages. It does not give medical advice.
It works inside your web browser. What you type is not sent to an AI company and is not saved.
Licensed clinicians, not software, decide whether you get treatment.
To reach a person, email support@wellpeps.com.
AI features in the technology platform that supports your care are described in section 6.
2. Who we are

WellPeps, a Wyoming corporation (“WellPeps”), is not a medical practice. It does not diagnose, prescribe or treat. Your clinical care is provided by independent licensed clinicians of [PRACTICE NAME] (the “Practice”). This page explains how WellPeps uses AI on its website and what you should know about AI in the platform that supports your care.
By “AI” we mean software that interprets your words or your information and produces an answer, a draft or a prediction.
3. The WellPeps assistant
3.1 What it is

The assistant is software, not a person. When you ask a question, it finds the closest match among pre-written answers taken from our articles, FAQs and program pages, and shows you the answer with links to its sources. It does this with simple word matching that runs on your own device. It does not write new answers using a generative AI model, and it does not send your question to an outside AI service.
3.2 What it does
Answers questions about our programs, pricing, the assessment, shipping, privacy and how our care works.
Shows where an answer came from, with a link to the article or page when there is one.
Points you to a person or a clinician when it cannot help.
3.3 What it does not do
It does not give medical advice, diagnose you, suggest a medicine or dose, or say whether a treatment is safe for you.
It does not decide whether you can get treatment. A clinician decides, and a prescription is not guaranteed.
It cannot see your account, orders, records or patient portal.
It cannot respond to emergencies.
It is not a person, a doctor, a nurse or any other licensed professional, and it will not say it is.
3.4 It can be wrong
Its answers come from our content, which may be out of date or incomplete. Check the linked source. For anything about your health or your treatment, ask a clinician.
3.5 Built-in safety checks

If your words suggest an emergency, the assistant shows an emergency message. If you ask a clinical question, such as what dose to take or whether a medicine is safe for you, it will not answer and will point you to a clinician. These checks look for key words and can miss things. Do not rely on them in an emergency.
4. Your information and the assistant
**What you type stays in your browser.** It is not sent to our servers or to any AI company, and we do not save it. When you close or refresh the page, the chat is gone.
**Please do not type** your name, health details, medicines, account numbers or other personal information. The assistant does not need them.
**Retention.** We keep none of what you type into the assistant. Because your questions are not sent to anyone, no AI model is trained on them.

**Ordinary website records.** Visiting wellpeps.com creates normal records, such as your IP address, the pages you view and your device type. We describe them in the Privacy Policy and, for health-related pages, the Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy. Those records do not include what you type into the assistant.
**If this changes,** we will update this page and the notice at the top of the chat window before the change takes effect.
5. If you need a person
**Email** support@wellpeps.com. Support hours are Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern time. We aim to reply within [1 business day].
**Phone:** (307) 881-8700, during normal business hours
**Medical questions.** If you are a WellPeps patient, message your care team in the patient portal at portal.wellpeps.com. WellPeps support staff cannot give medical advice.
**Emergencies.** Call 911.
The assistant cannot connect you to a person inside the chat. It will show you these options.
6. AI in your care

No AI tool at WellPeps makes decisions about your care. Your clinicians decide whether you receive treatment and what you receive. The technology platform that supports your care (the patient portal, the intake forms and your clinician’s workspace) includes optional AI features that the Practice, and in one case WellPeps, can switch on or off:
a tool that drafts visit notes from information in your chart;
a chart assistant that a clinician can ask questions about one patient’s chart; and
a tool that drafts a reply to a message for staff to edit.
**Choose ONE version of the rest of this section after the Practice answers open item 2. Delete the other version and this note.**
Version A. Use only if the Practice confirms in writing that these features are off and not used

These features are switched off. [PRACTICE NAME] has told us that it does not use AI to write notes about your visits, to answer questions about your chart, or to draft messages to you. If that changes, we will update this page before the change takes effect.
Version B. Use if the Practice uses any of them

**Visit notes and chart review.** A clinician may use an AI tool to draft notes about your visit or to ask questions about your chart. The tool may use your intake answers, forms, orders, earlier visit notes, lab results and, for a video visit, a transcript. The clinician edits the draft, reviews it and is responsible for your record.
**Messages.** Staff may use an AI tool to draft a reply to your message. A person reads and edits every draft before it is sent.

**Who receives your information.** These tools send the information they use to an AI service provider ([AI VENDOR]) that runs the model for our platform. [VERIFY: AI vendor terms] The provider must protect your information under a written agreement and may not use it to train its own models.
**No AI decisions.** AI does not decide whether you are treated or which medicine you get. Your clinician makes those decisions and signs them.

**Messages written by generative AI.** If the Practice sends you a message about your health that was written by generative AI and was not read and approved by a licensed clinician, the message will say so at the start and tell you how to reach a person.
**Recording and transcripts.** If a video visit is recorded or transcribed, the clinician will tell you first and, where the law requires, ask for your permission. [VERIFY: recording laws]
**Your choice.** You can ask the Practice not to use AI tools in your care. Send a message in the patient portal. The Practice will answer your request.
Some states, including California, Texas, Utah and Colorado, have laws about AI in health care or in consumer chat tools. We follow the law that applies where you are. [VERIFY: state AI laws]
7. Your choices
You do not need to use the assistant to buy anything or to get care. Closing the chat window ends the chat.
You can ask for a person at any time (section 5).
You can ask the Practice about AI in your care, or ask a person to review something you are unhappy with, by sending a message in the portal at portal.wellpeps.com.
If information about you is wrong, you can ask for a correction as the Notice of Privacy Practices explains.
If you have a concern about this page or the assistant, email support@wellpeps.com.
8. How WellPeps oversees AI
Before WellPeps starts using a new AI tool, [COMPLIANCE OFFICER] reviews what information it uses, who receives it, how it can fail and whether the law requires a notice.
No AI vendor receives patient information unless the written agreement the law requires is in place, and that agreement does not let the vendor use the information to train its own models.
The assistant answers only from content we have reviewed. We review changes to that content before they go live.
We test the emergency and clinical-question responses whenever we change the assistant.
Staff may not enter patient information into AI tools we have not approved.
We keep a record of changes and review this page at least once a year and whenever our use of AI changes.
9. Changes
We update this page when our use of AI or the law changes. The date at the top shows the latest version. We will update this page, and the notice in the chat window, before a change takes effect.
10. Contact
WellPeps, a Wyoming corporation, 30 N Gould St., Suite R, Sheridan, WY 82801. Email support@wellpeps.com. Phone: (307) 881-8700, during normal business hours.
Technical and drafting notes
**For the team, not part of the document.** These are instructions for WellPeps, counsel and the people who build the forms and pages. They are collected here so the document above reads on its own.

blocks.text: Part 3. Ready-to-activate block for the vector-search upgrade (internal: keep OFF)

**Do not activate until the checklist is done.** Today no question text leaves the browser, and Part 1 section 4 says so. The planned upgrade (the comment in assistant.ts says to replace getKnowledgeBase() with a Supabase vector search) changes that. The assistant, this page and the privacy policies must change together, before launch.
3.1 Checklist

items: Decide what is sent and kept: the question text only; no account, order or patient data; no profile linked to an IP address; a retention period of [30 days] and then deletion; a named person who may read logs.

Vendor review. Supabase (database host) and, if an outside model creates embeddings or answers, [AI VENDOR]. Written terms that allow processing only on our instructions, bar training on inputs, require deletion and set security. Decide whether a business associate agreement is needed, or build the assistant so it warns against and filters health details. [VERIFY: AI vendor terms]

Notice before the first question. Show the activated banner and first message below, and consider a click to start chatting. A chat sent to a third party can raise wiretap claims (California CIPA); counsel to advise.
Analytics. Exclude and mask the assistant input in PostHog, Curve, session replay and ad pixels.
Guardrails. Re-test the emergency and clinical-question replies, and block obvious personal data (card and Social Security numbers).
Content. Every knowledge-base answer goes through the compliance review. The current file is labelled mock data.

Update the Privacy Policy, the Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy and, if relevant, the Cookie and Tracking Technologies Notice (categories, purposes, retention, vendors). Then swap in the text below on this page.
Security review: rate limits, abuse protection, and keys kept on the server only.

blocks.text: 3.2 Replacement for Part 1 section 4

**Your information and the assistant.** When you ask a question, what you type is sent over an encrypted connection to our database provider, Supabase (and, if an outside model is used, [AI VENDOR]), which searches our articles for the best match. We keep your question text for [30 days] to fix problems and improve the assistant, and then delete it. We do not link it to your name, account or orders. We do not allow our providers to use it to train their own AI models. Please do not type your name, health details, medicines or other personal information. If you do, it may be stored for that period.
3.3 Replacement banner and first message

**Banner:** Automated assistant, not a person. No medical advice. Your questions are sent to our servers. Emergency? Call 911.
**First message:** Hi! I’m the WellPeps assistant, an automated program. I’m not a person or a clinician. I answer questions about WellPeps using our articles and program pages, and I show my sources. I can’t give medical advice or help in an emergency. If you think you are having one, call 911. To reach a person, email support@wellpeps.com. What you type is sent to our servers to find answers and is kept for [30 days]. Please don’t type personal or health details.
3.4 If the assistant ever writes answers with a generative AI model

Part 1 sections 3.1 and 3.3 must change to say so, name the provider, and explain that answers are written by a generative model and can be wrong. Re-check the Utah and California duties in Part 4 and the vendor terms before launch. Do not turn this on without a new review.
